title: Perils of Label Indeterminacy: A Case Study on Prediction of Neurological Recovery After Cardiac Arrest
reasoning: The paper investigates the technical and epistemological concept of 'label indeterminacy' in machine learning models used for clinical prognosis. While it discusses the ethical implications of these models in high-stakes healthcare settings, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethical reasoning frameworks as a primary component of the study.
